instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure default language is Burmese (my) with instant toggle to English (en). Provide full bilingual translations for all UI text, product titles, badges, and Burmese payment/support instructions.
Display all product prices clearly formatted in MMK (e.g., 25,000 MMK or 25,000 Ks).
Incorporate the sticky header with full navigation items, brand logo, search modal, EN/MM language switcher, and dark mode toggle.

Storefront structure should match the layout/IA inspired by microwavecreation.com: Sticky top bar, high impact hero promo banner, category navigation ribbon, featured products grid, digital services showcase, why choose us trust metrics, clear FAQ, and detailed footer.
Order creation must support direct seamless flow to Telegram and Messenger with pre-populated order summaries (Product, Plan, Price in MMK, Customer ID).

Admin dashboard at /admin must include statistics overview, product management table, order inbox supporting all 13 status badges, supplier integration manager, and order detail drawer with payment verification and delivery account details.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, status badges, and modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties like hover:bg-blue-700.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
